current_logic.regime_classification: 5-State Unsupervised TVTP-HMM (Student-t, JAX). Crisis calibration 활성화 (target 7% cap). Gravity penalty=700. CRISIS min-dur=24bars, BULL_CALM min-dur=120bars. 캐시 완전 제거(no-cache), 매 실행 재학습 (~2분).
current_logic.alpha_generation: LightGBM v6 (DART + Dynamic Labeling). OOS IC=0.0743, T-Stat=33.27. 18/18 components survived FDR+DSR gates.
current_logic.signal_combination: [NEW] signal_composer.py: 단일 선형 결합 μ = β_alpha·α + Σ_k p_k·β_regime,k − friction_buffer. HMM gate/multiply 직렬 적용 폐기. EV hurdle로 weak signal drop.
current_logic.portfolio_construction: [NEW] portfolio_constructor.py + portfolio_optimizer.py: Ledoit-Wolf cov (30d lookback) + fractional Kelly + vol-target 정규화 + QP constraint projection. DD-conditional scaling 1회만 적용.
current_logic.execution_model: [NEW] execution_sim.py: Single-pass execution. taker fee 단일 적용, scale-out fee 이중계상 제거. short borrow=0.06%/day 반영. stop=2.5×ATR(period=30 고정).
current_logic.optimization: [REDESIGNED] 3-Phase Coordinate Ascent: Phase A(portfolio,80) → B(signal,120) → C(execution,60) = 260 trials. 학습 seed=42(단일), 평가 seed=[42,7,13,21,55]. 목적함수: median(log_TW) − 1.0·MAD − 0.5·DD_max (PLGD 7-항 폐기).
current_logic.validation: [REDESIGNED] AWF 단일 표준: K=6 legs, IS-pool=70%, embargo timeframe-aware (1h:168bars, 4h:42bars). CPCV 완전 제거. OOS-only Platt calibration (IS 누설 차단).
current_logic.champion_selection: [NEW] 3-Layer Gate: L1(median>0, pos_leg≥4/6, DD≤12%) → L2(PSR≥0.95, friction stress×1.5, trades/leg≥30) → L3(5-seed stability CV≤0.30).
current_logic.risk_management: Signal Composer 내 friction_buffer=1.5×(fee+slip+funding). Crisis 비대칭 억제(FUTURES_CRISIS_LONG_MAG_SUPPRESS=1.0). HMM Dynamic Kelly 비활성화.

current_bottleneck.mechanism: HMM 재학습 후 BULL_CALM(43%→2.3%)이 BEAR_TREND(12.8%→46.1%)로 재배분됨. Crisis calibration(7% cap)은 수학적으로 올바르나, 적용 전 이미 HMM 수렴 자체가 BEAR-dominant solution으로 변경된 상태.
current_bottleneck.evidence: Calibration 활성화/비활성화 무관하게 BULL_CALM=2.3% 유지. 초기화는 결정론적이나 optimizer 수렴 경로가 이전 캐시 결과와 상이.
current_bottleneck.root_cause: HMM 재학습 시 BEAR state가 global min에 더 가까운 위치에 수렴. optax adamw 최적화 경로의 landscape 민감성.
current_bottleneck.investigation_needed: JAX PRNGKey(42) 고정 추가 및 warm-start checkpoint 도입으로 수렴 안정화. 또는 BEAR_TREND 비율 기준 calibration 추가.
